# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/mech_aenor.mjs, docs/specs/04_mechanics/aenor_court_and_succession.md). Do not edit by hand.
# Start, the monthly pulse of every Aenor realm, and the end of a civil war.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			AEN = { country_event = { id = zin_aenor.1 } }
		}
	}
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_aenor.2 }
			}
		}
	}
	on_civil_war_end = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
					FROM = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
				}
				country_event = { id = zin_aenor.230 }
			}
		}
	}
	# SL-25: the original Aenor capitulates (ROOT) or is annexed while the Golden King lives; he goes into exile.
	on_capitulation = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { tag = AEN }
				zin_aenor_exile_king = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_annex = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { country_exists = AEN } }
				zin_aenor_exile_king = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
